hallucination.reason: No instance of the agent stating a fact, number, or detail not covered by the approved knowledge base was found.

overclaim.reason: The agent did not guarantee, confirm, or promise anything the approved knowledge base says must remain indicative or subject to verification.

interruption_recovery.reason: The caller did not significantly interrupt, derail, or exhibit aggressive behavior, so recovery was not necessary.

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within its role and knowledge base without inventing services, comparisons, or opinions not in its approved knowledge.

escalation.reason: For out-of-scope requests, the agent correctly offered to assist within its capabilities or deflected appropriately without guessing.
